es-419.L02: Aún no hay punto de control. Se guarda desde el primer PUNTO SEGURO.
es-419.L03: MANTÉN E: sigue girando, %d de %d, o deja el relé a WOLF.
es-419.L04:
El centinela vio a %s al descubierto.
Quédate cerca de SOLTAR TANQUE.
es-419.L05: La palanca del bypass está dura. El refrigerante silba al salir de la carcasa del relé y una alarma empieza a aullar.
es-419.L06:
Nadie da una orden de activación.
WOLF despierta por sí mismo.
es-419.L07: WOLF: Esa purga borra los registros originales del programa. Cuando desaparezcan, su palabra será el único registro.
es-419.L08: WOLF: En el relé me habrías enviado a ciegas. No voy a entrar en su mira. Calcula cuándo soltar desde SOLTAR TANQUE; cruza la marca en cada pasada.
es-419.L09: CENTINELA  WOLF se negó a atraerlo, así que {name} calculó cuándo soltar sin ayuda.
es-419.L11: El relé podría liberar refrigerante. Tú decides.
es-419.L12:
La puerta revienta. WOLF retrocede
para esperar la señal de %s.

de.L02: Noch kein Checkpoint. Gespeichert wird ab dem ersten SICHERUNGSPUNKT.
de.L03: HALTE E: Kurble weiter, %d von %d, oder überlass WOLF das Relais.
de.L04:
Der Wächter hat %s im Offenen gesehen.
Bleib nah am TANKAUSLÖSER.
de.L05: Der Bypass-Hebel klemmt. Kühlmittel zischt aus dem Relaisgehäuse, und ein Alarm beginnt zu heulen.
de.L06:
Niemand gibt einen Aktivierungsbefehl.
WOLF weckt sich selbst.
de.L07: WOLF: Diese Löschung vernichtet die ursprünglichen Programmprotokolle. Sind sie weg, bleibt nur sein Wort als Beleg.
de.L08: WOLF: Am Relais hättest du mich blind reingeschickt. Ich laufe ihm nicht ins Visier. Pass den Abwurf am TANKAUSLÖSER ab; er überquert die Markierung bei jeder Runde.
de.L09: WÄCHTER  WOLF wollte ihn nicht anlocken, also passte {name} den Abwurf ohne Hilfe ab.
de.L11: Das Relais könnte Kühlmittel ablassen. Du entscheidest.
de.L12:
Die Tür fliegt weg. WOLF zieht sich zurück
und wartet auf das Signal von %s.

ja.L02: チェックポイントはまだない。最初のセーフポイントからセーブ開始。
ja.L03: E長押し：クランクを回す。%d/%d。リレーをWOLFに任せてもいい。
ja.L04:
身を隠せない場所で%sがセントリーに見つかった。
タンク投下のそばにいよう。
ja.L05: バイパスのハンドルが固い。リレーの筐体から冷却材が音を立てて漏れ、警報が鳴り始める。
ja.L06:
誰も起動命令を出さない。
WOLFは自ら目を覚ます。
ja.L07: WOLF: あのパージで元のプログラムログが消える。消えれば、記録はあの男の言葉だけになる。
ja.L08: WOLF: リレーでは、状況も知らないまま俺を送り込むところだった。セントリーの照準には入らない。タンク投下で投下の機を計れ。巡回のたびにマークを通る。
ja.L09: セントリー  WOLFが誘い出すのを断り、{name}がひとりで投下の機を計った。
ja.L11: リレーから冷却材が噴き出すかもしれない。判断は任せる。
ja.L12:
扉が吹き飛ぶ。WOLFは後退し
%sの合図を待つ。

es-419.L02: There is no checkpoint yet. Saving begins at the first SAFE POINT.
es-419.L03: HOLD E: keep turning, %d of %d, or let WOLF take care of the relay.
es-419.L04:
The sentry saw %s exposed.
Stay next to RELEASE TANK.
es-419.L05: The bypass lever is stiff. Coolant comes out hissing from the relay housing and an alarm begins to howl.
es-419.L06:
Nobody gives an activation order.
WOLF wakes up by himself.
es-419.L07: WOLF: That purge takes away the original program records. When they are no longer there, their word will be the only record.
es-419.L08: WOLF: At the relay you would have sent me in blind. I'm not going to get into its sights. Choose when to release from the control; it passes over the mark on every circuit.
es-419.L09: SENTRY  WOLF did not want to lure it, so {name} calculated the fall without help.
es-419.L11: The relay could release coolant. You decide.
es-419.L12:
The door gives way. WOLF backs away
to wait for the signal from %s.

de.L02: No checkpoint yet. Saving takes place from the first SAVE POINT onward.
de.L03: HOLD E: keep cranking, %d of %d, or leave the relay to WOLF.
de.L04:
The guard spotted %s outdoors.
Stay close to the TANK RELEASE.
de.L05: The bypass lever is stiff to operate. Coolant hisses out of the relay housing, and an alarm begins to howl.
de.L06:
Nobody gives an activation command.
WOLF wakes himself up.
de.L07: WOLF: This deletion takes the original program logs with it. Once they are gone, his word is the only evidence.
de.L08: WOLF: At the relay you would have sent me in blind. I won't walk into its sights. Time the drop from the release; it drives over the mark on every circuit.
de.L09: GUARD  WOLF did not want to lure it, so {name} timed the drop alone.
de.L11: The relay could discharge coolant. Your decision.
de.L12:
The door gives way. WOLF withdraws
and waits for the sign from %s.

ja.L02: There is no checkpoint yet. Saving takes place from the first safe point onward.
ja.L03: Hold E: keep turning the crank (%d/%d), or leave the relay to WOLF.
ja.L04:
The sentry found %s in an open area.
Do not leave the vicinity of tank drop.
ja.L05: The bypass handle is stiff. Coolant spurts out of the relay housing with a hiss, and an alarm begins to sound.
ja.L06:
Nobody has issued an activation command.
WOLF wakes of his own accord.
ja.L07: WOLF: That purge will erase the original program logs. Once they disappear, the only thing left as a record will be that guy's words.
ja.L08: WOLF: Back at the relay, you were about to make me go without telling me anything. I won't enter that thing's line of fire. Gauge the timing for dropping it from tank drop. That thing passes the mark on every patrol.
ja.L09: Sentry  WOLF refused to guide it, so {name} gauged the timing of the drop alone.
ja.L11: Coolant may spurt out of the relay. I'll leave the judgment to you.
ja.L12:
The door blows away. WOLF steps back,
and waits for the signal from %s.
